Professional Summary
Frontend-focused engineer with cross-functional experience building user-facing applications and backend services. Skilled at designing performant React and Next.js interfaces, implementing GraphQL APIs, and developing reliable Go-based services. Proven track record of shipping features end-to-end in Agile teams and improving product metrics through focused engineering.

Technical Skills
React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, Cypress, Go, gRPC, Agile

Work Experience

Frontend Engineer, NimbusSoft (Dec 2024 - Jun 2026)
- Led development of a Next.js customer portal, implementing server-side rendering and incremental static regeneration using Next.js and TypeScript to reduce TTFB by 35% while improving perceived load time; collaborated with product and QA in Agile sprints. (Next.js, React, GraphQL)
- Built GraphQL integrations and client caching layers to fetch personalized data, cutting mobile API calls by 40% and improving cache hit rates; added TypeScript types across the stack to prevent runtime errors. (GraphQL, TypeScript, React)
- Implemented responsive UI components with Tailwind CSS and wrote end-to-end Cypress tests covering critical user flows, increasing release confidence and reducing post-release bugs by 28%. (Tailwind CSS, Cypress, React)

Frontend Engineer, Razorpay (May 2024 - Nov 2024)
- Developed payment onboarding flows using React and Next.js, optimizing form validation and client-side routing to reduce drop-off during signup by 22%; integrated with existing GraphQL endpoints for data. (React, Next.js)
- Created reusable React components with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS to standardize UI across merchant dashboards, improving development velocity for feature teams. (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Partnered with backend teams in Agile ceremonies to define API contracts and added Cypress test suites for critical checkout scenarios to maintain reliability during high-traffic events. (Cypress, Agile, React)

Backend Engineer, Orbit Health (Jun 2022 - Apr 2024)
- Designed and implemented gRPC services in Go for real-time clinical data ingestion, achieving throughput improvements of 3x and reducing latency for downstream processing. (Go, gRPC)
- Built robust service-to-service GraphQL wrappers and migrations to expose aggregated patient data to frontend teams, ensuring typed contracts and backward compatibility. (gRPC, Go, GraphQL)
- Automated integration tests and contributed to Agile planning, enabling predictable two-week deliveries and reducing hotfixes by implementing thorough test coverage. (Go, gRPC, Agile)
